subject.why: The compass is immediately recognizable with its open brass casing, loop, red needle, and the requested star detail at the north position.

category.why: The compass floats with a clear three-quarter tilt against a saturated background with radiating light rays centered behind it.

clean.why: There is no text, card frame, UI, watermark, or characters present.

framing.why: The compass is well-centered with ample margins around the edges, and nothing is cut off.

colour.why: Vibrant and saturated with rich warm brass and red tones that contrast sharply against the bright blue background.

detail.why: The surfaces are smooth with chunky, simplified dial markers and no unnecessary micro-textures or scratches.

style.why: The rendering features soft satin sheen, rounded 3D volumes, and no outlines, matching the reference cards.
